Orchestre des Concerts Lamoureux (orchestra), Maurice Ravel (conductor) Documented

Commons attributes this complete transfer to Ravel in 1930. BnF confirms Ravel/Lamoureux and a 1935 published pressing. The session month, venue and actual transferred pressing are not established.

Territorial: EU public domain; this Ravel/Lamoureux recording was published no later than 1935. Documented

Programme rule 3. BnF’s P 1935 Polydor issue establishes publication before 1963, without treating the Commons composition-only PD-old-70 tag as a recording licence. US status is not established. Upstream Typepad page now redirects to an unavailable parked domain.
